confidence_notes: Holistic estimate for July 2026, at or just past my knowledge horizon, so values are extrapolated rather than checked against listings. Restaurant anchors are most reliable; July hostel and hotel rates are least certain. Cocktail and wine are set from the beer anchor (about 2.6x and 2.4x) because direct knowledge is weaker. FX reading is from a search summary of the RBA overview page, not the F11.1 table; a newer 14 Oct reading was reported by a secondary source but not verified.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. Based on South Korean regional price levels: Busan restaurant and lodging costs sit somewhat below Seoul, with a July peak-season adjustment applied to accommodation.
